statements: CREATE TABLE "app_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"))
CREATE TABLE "clues" ("content_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "clue_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "text_tr" TEXT NOT NULL, "text_en" TEXT NULL, "unlocked_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("content_id", "clue_id"))
CREATE TABLE "gate_progress" ("content_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "node_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("content_id", "item_kind", "node_id"))
CREATE TABLE "hi_records" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("kind", "ref_id"))

CREATE TABLE "learning_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "client_event_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "content_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_type" TEXT NULL, "error_taxonomy_version" INTEGER NULL, "client_id" TEXT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "notebook_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "item_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "text_en" TEXT NOT NULL, "text_tr" TEXT NULL, "example_en" TEXT NULL, "example_tr" TEXT NULL, "content_id" TEXT NULL, "cue_id" TEXT NULL, "image_path" TEXT NULL, "image_crop" TEXT NULL, "audio_path" TEXT NULL, "audio_start" REAL NULL, "audio_end" REAL NULL, "example_start" REAL NULL, "example_end" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_title" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "review_cards" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES notebook_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "state" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "step" INTEGER NULL, "stability" REAL NULL, "difficulty" REAL NULL, "due" TEXT NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lapses" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_review" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "review_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "card_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_cards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "rating" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reviewed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "correct" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("correct" IN (0, 1)), "dont_know" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dont_know" IN (0, 1)), "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "was_new" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("was_new" IN (0, 1)), "client_id" TEXT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "season_state" ("season_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "intro_seen" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("intro_seen" IN (0, 1)), "intro_seen_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("season_id"))

CREATE TABLE "speech_attempts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "place" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_id" TEXT NULL, "item_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "match_level" TEXT NOT NULL, "missing_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "error_note_id" TEXT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "story_links" ("content_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "open_question_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "open_question_tr" TEXT NULL, "answers" TEXT NOT NULL, "partial_notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("content_id"))

CREATE TABLE "sync_outbox" ("tbl" TEXT NOT NULL, "k1" TEXT NOT NULL, "k2" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "k3" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "changed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "blocked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("blocked" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("tbl", "k1", "k2", "k3"))

CREATE TABLE "sync_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "account_user_id" TEXT NULL, "email_masked" TEXT NULL, "account_status" TEXT NULL, "scheduled_purge_at" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "last_pull_cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_sync_at" TEXT NULL, "last_push_at" TEXT NULL, "initial_upload_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("initial_upload_done" IN (0, 1)), "applying" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("applying" IN (0, 1)), "pending_speech_delete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_speech_delete" IN (0, 1)), "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, "signed_out_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "user_book_progress" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_STARTED', "chapter_id" TEXT NULL, "page_number" INTEGER NULL, "sentence_index" INTEGER NULL, "position_sec" REAL NULL, "started_at" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id"))
CREATE TABLE "user_story_flags" ("content_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "flag" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("content_id", "flag"))

CREATE TABLE "user_story_progress" ("content_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_STARTED', "last_checkpoint_node_id" TEXT NULL, "checkpoint_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("content_id"))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_events_client_id ON learning_events (client_id)
CREATE INDEX review_cards_due ON review_cards (due)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX review_logs_client_id ON review_logs (client_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX speech_attempts_client_id ON speech_attempts (client_id)
